# DigitalOcean

DigitalOcean is a cloud infrastructure provider offering scalable compute platforms with a user-friendly interface.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/digital-ocean/.

## Actions

- **Create Custom Image**: Create a new custom image by providing a url to a linux vm image.
- **Create Database Cluster**: Create a new managed database cluster.
- **Create Domain Record**: Create a new dns record for a domain.
- **Create New Block Storage Volume**: Create a new block storage volume.
- **Create New Domain**: Create a new domain.
- **Create New Droplet**: Create a new droplet.
- **Create New Firewall**: Create a new firewall.
- **Create New Kubernetes Cluster**: Create a new kubernetes cluster.
- **Create New Load Balancer**: Create a new load balancer.
- **Create New SSH Key**: Create a new ssh key.
- **Create New Tag**: Create a new tag.
- **Create New VPC**: Create a new vpc.
- **Delete Block Storage Volume**: Delete a block storage volume by id.
- **Delete Database Cluster**: Delete a database cluster by uuid.
- **Delete Domain**: Delete a domain by name.
- **Delete Domain Record**: Delete a dns record by its record id for a domain.
- **Delete Existing Droplet**: Delete a droplet by id.
- **Delete Firewall**: Delete a firewall by id.
- **Delete Image**: Delete a snapshot or custom image by id.
- **Delete Load Balancer**: Delete a load balancer instance by id.
- **Delete SSH Key**: Delete a public ssh key.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag by name.
- **Delete VPC**: Delete a vpc by its id.
- **List All Databases**: List all managed database clusters on your account.
- **List All Domains**: List all domains in your digitalocean account.
- **List All Droplets**: List all droplets in your account.
- **List All Firewalls**: List all firewalls on your digitalocean account.
- **List All Images**: List all images available on your account.
- **List All Kubernetes Clusters**: List all kubernetes clusters on your account.
- **List All Load Balancers**: List all load balancer instances on your account.
- **List All Snapshots**: List all snapshots available on your digitalocean account.
- **List All SSH Keys**: List all ssh keys in your account.
- **List All Tags**: List all tags in your account.
- **List All Volumes**: List all block storage volumes available on your account.
- **List All VPCs**: List all vpcs on your account.
- **List Database Options**: List valid database engine, version, region, and size options.
- **List Domain Records**: List all dns records for a domain.
- **Retrieve Domain**: Retrieve details about a specific domain by its name.
- **Retrieve Domain Record**: Retrieve a specific dns record for a domain by its record id.
- **Retrieve Existing Droplet**: Show information about an individual droplet by id.
- **Retrieve Existing Image**: Retrieve information about an image by id or slug.
- **Retrieve Tag**: Retrieve an individual tag by name.
- **Retrieve VPC**: Retrieve details about a specific vpc by its id.
- **Tag Resource**: Tag resources by name.
- **Untag Resource**: Untag resources by tag name.
- **Update Domain Record**: Update an existing dns record for a domain.
- **Update VPC**: Update information about a vpc.
